Unit Rendering Reference Implementation

A working, tested proof of concept for the four rendering upgrades from the build plan — smooth interpolated movement, bearing-driven directional icons, symbol collision avoidance, and a pulsing "engaged" halo — built against the real placement data from Day 3, ticks 540–600 (the cannonade into Pickett's Charge).

This is a standalone reference page, not wired into the live map (that map's own rendering code is inside a compiled bundle with no source project to edit). Everything below runs for real, against real data, in this actual browser — it's meant to be copied into the real app's source the moment that project is recovered or rebuilt.
Tick 540
Real placement data loaded (ticks 540–600, Day 3)
Every placement has a real bearing value used for rotation
Positions interpolate frame-by-frame between ticks, not jump
Symbol collision engine active (icon-allow-overlap: false, sorted by strength)
Halo layer pulsing on engaged dispositions
